accept_guard.note: Fires only when ALL hold: attrs.status == 1 AND instance.issue.state is set AND state.group == 'triage' AND no State row (workspace, project, default=True) exists. status sent as string '1' does NOT fire (attrs.get('status') == 1 is int-strict). status=1 with non-triage state skips the check and (via update) performs no transition.

triage_transition.note: Transition happens AFTER super().update; issue.save() is a plain save (no update_fields). If default_state lookup returns None at update time (deleted between validate and save) the issue keeps its triage state silently.
triage_transition.rule: update() serializers/intake.py:138-157: super().update(instance, validated_data); if validated_data.status == 1 and issue.state.group == 'triage': default = State(workspace, project, default=True).first(); if default: issue.state = default; issue.save()
